scripts.build:samples: npm run build --prefix lessons/07-mcp/code && npm run build --prefix lessons/07-mcp/solution && npm run build --prefix lessons/08-mcp-advanced/solutions
scripts.test: npm test --prefix app && npm run test:samples && npm run test:docs
scripts.genai:translate: npx genaiscript@latest run translator "./lessons/*/README.md" --no-run-trace --remote https://github.com/pelikhan/action-continuous-translation --remote-install -x glossaryFile=glossary.md -x lang=fr -x "filenameTemplate={{dirname}}/translations/{{basename}}.{{lang}}{{extname}}"
